title: "Living data-management plan"
last-reviewed: "2026-09-08"

Build this plan around the material the project will actually create. Start with one sensitive or irreplaceable item and trace it from collection to its final custodian or authorised disposal.

Reconcile this plan with current institutional, ethics, legal, contractual, funder, community and data-custodian requirements. Keep protected details in an approved location.

## Completed example excerpt

*Illustrative example; replace these details with your own verified record.*

| Material | Purpose/source | Sensitivity | Authoritative location | Custodian |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| consent forms | evidence of consent | directly identifying | restricted institutional records drive | chief investigator |
| interview audio | transcription and verification | identifiable and sensitive | encrypted approved research storage | chief investigator |
| linkage key | connect study ID to participant | directly identifying | separate restricted vault | data manager |
| coded transcript | approved analysis | pseudonymised; contextual re-identification possible | controlled team workspace | candidate |
| analysis code | reproducibility | non-sensitive after review | private version-controlled repository | candidate |

**Restore test:** one encrypted audio file and its metadata were restored to an approved test folder, checksum matched, permissions were reapplied and recovery took 18 minutes. The test revealed that the linkage-key location was missing from the continuity document; this was corrected before collection.

## Check your record

Verify the named locations, permissions and recovery route in practice. A planned control and a tested control should be distinguishable in the retained evidence.

## Scenario test

A collaborator says their personal cloud drive is easier for sharing. The plan has no authority for that location and the data agreement limits transfer. Do not add the folder to the plan as a convenience. Keep data in the approved system, test an authorised collaboration route and seek written amendment if the current arrangement cannot support the necessary work.
